title: निर्माता अधिकारीको अभिव्यक्तिमा दीपकराजको आपत्ति, मानहानिको मुद्दा हाल्ने चेतावनी
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । गत दशैंको छेकोमा प्रदर्शनमा आएको चलचित्र ‘छ माया छपक्कै २’ बक्स अफिसमा फ्लप भएपछि निर्माता रोहित अधिकारी र मुख्य अभिनेता दीपकराज गिरीबीच विवाद चर्किएको छ । अधिकारीले नेपाल प्रेसमा दिएको अभिव्यक्तिप्रति गिरीले आपत्ति जनाएका छन् । चलचित्रका एकल निर्माता अधिकारीले ‘छ माया छपक्कै २’ मा ३ करोड ४० लाख लगानी गर्दा डेढ करोड घाटा खाएको नेपाल प्रेसलाई बताएका थिए । उनले गिरीप्रति विभिन्न विषयमा असन्तुष्टिसमेत पोखेका छन् । गिरीले आफूखुसी स्क्रिप्टमा छेडछाड गरेको, सेन्सर पासअघि आफूलाई चलचित्र हेर्नसमेत नदिइएको, ओभरसिज राइट्स आफूखुसी विक्री गरेको, चलचित्रमा आफूलाई थाहा नदिई ठूला दुई कम्पनीका विज्ञापन समावेश गरेको लगायत आरोपहरू उनले लगाएका थिए । अभिनेता गिरीले भने यसलाई अनावश्यक मिडियाबाजीको संज्ञा दिएका छन् । अधिकारीले नै सबैभन्दा पहिले सम्झौता नै उल्लंघन गरेको उनको आरोप छ । गिरीले नेपाल प्रेससँग भने, ‘मलाई मिडियाबाजी गर्नु छैन । जे बोल्छ, सबै कुरा कागजले बोल्छ । असन्तुष्टि भए कानुनी प्रक्रियामा जाने हो, मिडियाबाजी गर्नुको कुनै तुक छैन ।’ दुई पक्षबीच भएको सम्झौताको १२ नम्बर बुँदा निर्माता अधिकारीले उल्लंघन गरेको गिरीको आरोप छ । सम्झौताको १२ नम्बर बुँदामा ‘गोपनीयता’ उपशीर्षक दिएर भनिएको छ, ‘यस करारसँग सम्बन्धित आर्थिक, व्यापारिक, प्राविधिक वा सृजनात्मक जानकारी दुवै पक्षले तेस्रो पक्षलाई आपसी लिखित सहमतिबिना खुलासा गर्न पाउने छैन ।’ यदि थप मिडियाबाजी गरेमा आफ्नो टिम मानहानिको मुद्दा लिएर कानुनी प्रक्रियामा समेत जाने तयारीबारे छलफल गरिरहेको गिरीले बताए । सबै कुरा सम्झौताको १२ नम्बर बुँदा र अन्य कागजातले बोलिसकेकाले आफूले थप धारणा नराख्ने उनको भनाइ छ । गिरीनिकट एक कानुनी व्यवसायी निर्माता अधिकारीमाथि मानहानि र बैंकिङ कसुरअन्तर्गत चेक बाउन्सको मुद्दा समेत लाग्न सक्ने बताउँछन् । ती कानुन व्यवसायीले भने, ‘उहाँका दुईवटा चेक हामीसँगै छन् । मानहानि मात्र होइन, अन्य मुद्दाहरू पनि आकर्षित हुनसक्ने देखिन्छ ।’ ओभरसिज राइट्सको उठ्न बाँकी पैसा गिरीले दिनु नपर्ने ती कानून व्यवसायीले बताए । विदेशबाट पैसा आएर गिरीले आफूसँगै राखेको भए मात्र अधिकारीलाई तिर्नुपर्ने उनको भनाइ छ । ‘चलचित्र फ्लप भएपछि ओभरसिजका वितरकहरूले लिन मानेनन् । चलचित्रबाट हात उठाएपछि कसरी पैसा आउँछ र ?’ ती कानुन व्यवसायीले भने, ‘पैसा ल्याएर आफूसँग राखेको भए पो तिर्नुपर्थ्यो !’ ‘छ माया छपक्कै २’ले अहिलेसम्म साढे तीन करोड जति मात्र ग्रस कलेक्सन गरेको छ । यस कलेक्सनबाट निर्माता अधिकारीको हातमा एक करोड १५ लाख जति आउने देखिन्छ । ओभरसिजबाट ६५ लाख जति आएको अधिकारीले बताए । चलचित्रको डिजिटल राइटस् पूर्वसहमतिअनुसार गिरीले पाएका छन् । चलचित्र असफल भएपछि सबै जिम्मेवारी आफूले एक्लै लिने गिरीले बताएका थिए । उनले ‘छ माया छपक्कै ३’ को घोषणा गरिसकेका छन् । चलचित्रको कपिराइट दीपकराजसँग भएकाले सिक्वेल पनि उनले नै बनाउने अधिकार पाएका हुन् । निर्माता अधिकारी पनि ‘छ माया छपक्कै २’का निर्देशक दीपेन्द्र लामासँग मिलेर अर्को चलचित्रको तयारीमा लागिसकेका छन् । Kathmandu. A dispute has erupted between producer Rohit Adhikari and lead actor Deepak Raj Giri after the film 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2', which was released in the last Dashain festival, flopped at the box office. Giri has objected to Adhikari's statement given to the Nepal Press. The film's sole producer, Adhikari, had told Nepal Press that he had lost Rs 1.5 crore while investing Rs 34 million in 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2'. He has also expressed dissatisfaction with Giri on various issues. He had made allegations that Giri had tampered with the script arbitrarily, that he was not even allowed to watch the film before it passed the censors, that he had sold the overseas rights arbitrarily, and that the film had included advertisements for two big companies without his knowledge. Actor Giri, however, has termed it as unnecessary media hype. He alleges that the official was the first to violate the agreement. Giri told Nepal Press, "I don't want to do media manipulation. Whatever is said, everything is said on paper. If there is dissatisfaction, we will go to the legal process, there is no point in doing media manipulation." Giri alleges that the production officer violated clause 12 of the agreement between the two parties. Clause 12 of the agreement, subtitled 'Confidentiality', states, 'Neither party shall disclose to any third party any financial, commercial, technical or creative information related to this agreement without mutual written consent.' Giri said that if there is any more media speculation, his team is discussing preparations to take legal action against the defamation case. He said that he will not comment further as everything has been said in point 12 of the agreement and other documents. A legal professional near Giri says that the official may be charged with defamation and a banking offense, including check bounce. The lawyer said, "We have two of his checks with us. It seems that not only defamation, but other cases may also be attracted." The lawyer said that Giri does not have to pay the remaining money for overseas rights. He said that Giri should only pay the official if the money came from abroad and was kept with him. "After the film flopped, overseas distributors refused to take it. How will the money come after the film is discontinued?" the lawyer said, "If he had brought the money and kept it with him, he would have had to pay!" 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2' has so far collected only around 3.5 crores. From this collection, the producer Adhikari is expected to earn around 1.5 crores. Adhikari said that around 6.5 lakhs have been earned from overseas. Giri has got the digital rights of the film as per the previous agreement. Giri had said that he would take all the responsibility alone after the film failed. He has already announced 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 3'. Since Deepak Raj owns the copyright of the film, he has also got the right to make the sequel. The production officer has also started preparing for another film in collaboration with 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2' director Dipendra Lama.

उनको आरोप छ । गिरीले नेपाल प्रेससँग भने, ‘मलाई मिडियाबाजी गर्नु छैन । जे बोल्छ, सबै कुरा कागजले बोल्छ । असन्तुष्टि भए कानुनी प्रक्रियामा जाने हो, मिडियाबाजी गर्नुको कुनै तुक छैन ।’ दुई पक्षबीच भएको सम्झौताको १२ नम्बर बुँदा निर्माता अधिकारीले उल्लंघन गरेको गिरीको आरोप छ । सम्झौताको १२ नम्बर बुँदामा ‘गोपनीयता’ उपशीर्षक दिएर भनिएको छ, ‘यस करारसँग सम्बन्धित आर्थिक, व्यापारिक, प्राविधिक वा सृजनात्मक जानकारी दुवै पक्षले तेस्रो पक्षलाई आपसी लिखित सहमतिबिना खुलासा गर्न पाउने छैन ।’ यदि थप मिडियाबाजी गरेमा आफ्नो टिम मानहानिको मुद्दा लिएर कानुनी प्रक्रियामा समेत जाने तयारीबारे छलफल गरिरहेको गिरीले बताए । सबै कुरा सम्झौताको १२ नम्बर बुँदा र अन्य कागजातले बोलिसकेकाले आफूले थप धारणा नराख्ने उनको भनाइ छ । गिरीनिकट एक कानुनी व्यवसायी निर्माता अधिकारीमाथि मानहानि र बैंकिङ कसुरअन्तर्गत चेक बाउन्सको मुद्दा समेत लाग्न सक्ने बताउँछन् । ती कानुन व्यवसायीले भने, ‘उहाँका दुईवटा चेक हामीसँगै छन् । मानहानि मात्र होइन, अन्य मुद्दाहरू पनि आकर्षित हुनसक्ने देखिन्छ ।’ ओभरसिज राइट्सको उठ्न बाँकी पैसा गिरीले दिनु नपर्ने ती कानून व्यवसायीले बताए । विदेशबाट पैसा आएर गिरीले आफूसँगै राखेको भए मात्र अधिकारीलाई तिर्नुपर्ने उनको भनाइ छ । ‘चलचित्र फ्लप भएपछि ओभरसिजका वितरकहरूले लिन मानेनन् । चलचित्रबाट हात उठाएपछि कसरी पैसा आउँछ र ?’ ती कानुन व्यवसायीले भने, ‘पैसा ल्याएर आफूसँग राखेको भए पो तिर्नुपर्थ्यो !’ ‘छ माया छपक्कै २’ले अहिलेसम्म साढे तीन करोड जति मात्र ग्रस कलेक्सन गरेको छ । यस कलेक्सनबाट निर्माता अधिकारीको हातमा एक करोड १५ लाख जति आउने देखिन्छ । ओभरसिजबाट ६५ लाख जति आएको अधिकारीले बताए । चलचित्रको डिजिटल राइटस् पूर्वसहमतिअनुसार गिरीले पाएका छन् । चलचित्र असफल भएपछि सबै जिम्मेवारी आफूले एक्लै लिने गिरीले बताएका थिए । उनले ‘छ माया छपक्कै ३’ को घोषणा गरिसकेका छन् । चलचित्रको कपिराइट दीपकराजसँग भएकाले सिक्वेल पनि उनले नै बनाउने अधिकार पाएका हुन् । निर्माता अधिकारी पनि ‘छ माया छपक्कै २’का निर्देशक दीपेन्द्र लामासँग मिलेर अर्को चलचित्रको तयारीमा लागिसकेका छन् । Kathmandu. A dispute has erupted between producer Rohit Adhikari and lead actor Deepak Raj Giri after the film 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2', which was released in the last Dashain festival, flopped at the box office. Giri has objected to Adhikari's statement given to the Nepal Press. The film's sole producer, Adhikari, had told Nepal Press that he had lost Rs 1.5 crore while investing Rs 34 million in 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2'. He has also expressed dissatisfaction with Giri on various issues. He had made allegations that Giri had tampered with the script arbitrarily, that he was not even allowed to watch the film before it passed the censors, that he had sold the overseas rights arbitrarily, and that the film had included advertisements for two big companies without his knowledge. Actor Giri, however, has termed it as unnecessary media hype. He alleges that the official was the first to violate the agreement. Giri told Nepal Press, "I don't want to do media manipulation. Whatever is said, everything is said on paper. If there is dissatisfaction, we will go to the legal process, there is no point in doing media manipulation." Giri alleges that the production officer violated clause 12 of the agreement between the two parties. Clause 12 of the agreement, subtitled 'Confidentiality', states, 'Neither party shall disclose to any third party any financial, commercial, technical or creative information related to this agreement without mutual written consent.' Giri said that if there is any more media speculation, his team is discussing preparations to take legal action against the defamation case. He said that he will not comment further as everything has been said in point 12 of the agreement and other documents. A legal professional near Giri says that the official may be charged with defamation and a banking offense, including check bounce. The lawyer said, "We have two of his checks with us. It seems that not only defamation, but other cases may also be attracted." The lawyer said that Giri does not have to pay the remaining money for overseas rights. He said that Giri should only pay the official if the money came from abroad and was kept with him. "After the film flopped, overseas distributors refused to take it. How will the money come after the film is discontinued?" the lawyer said, "If he had brought the money and kept it with him, he would have had to pay!" 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2' has so far collected only around 3.5 crores. From this collection, the producer Adhikari is expected to earn around 1.5 crores. Adhikari said that around 6.5 lakhs have been earned from overseas. Giri has got the digital rights of the film as per the previous agreement. Giri had said that he would take all the responsibility alone after the film failed. He has already announced 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 3'. Since Deepak Raj owns the copyright of the film, he has also got the right to make the sequel. The production officer has also started preparing for another film in collaboration with 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2' director Dipendra Lama.

जानकारी दुवै पक्षले तेस्रो पक्षलाई आपसी लिखित सहमतिबिना खुलासा गर्न पाउने छैन ।’ यदि थप मिडियाबाजी गरेमा आफ्नो टिम मानहानिको मुद्दा लिएर कानुनी प्रक्रियामा समेत जाने तयारीबारे छलफल गरिरहेको गिरीले बताए । सबै कुरा सम्झौताको १२ नम्बर बुँदा र अन्य कागजातले बोलिसकेकाले आफूले थप धारणा नराख्ने उनको भनाइ छ । गिरीनिकट एक कानुनी व्यवसायी निर्माता अधिकारीमाथि मानहानि र बैंकिङ कसुरअन्तर्गत चेक बाउन्सको दिनु नपर्ने ती कानून व्यवसायीले बताए । विदेशबाट पैसा आएर गिरीले आफूसँगै राखेको भए मात्र अधिकारीलाई तिर्नुपर्ने उनको भनाइ छ । ‘चलचित्र फ्लप भएपछि ओभरसिजका वितरकहरूले लिन मानेनन् । चलचित्रबाट हात निर्माता अधिकारीको हातमा एक करोड १५ लाख जति आउने देखिन्छ । ओभरसिजबाट ६५ लाख जति आएको अधिकारीले बताए । चलचित्रको डिजिटल राइटस् पूर्वसहमतिअनुसार गिरीले पाएका छन् । चलचित्र असफल भएपछि सबै जिम्मेवारी आफूले एक्लै लिने गिरीले बताएका थिए । उनले ‘छ माया छपक्कै ३’ को घोषणा गरिसकेका छन् । चलचित्रको कपिराइट दीपकराजसँग भएकाले सिक्वेल पनि उनले नै बनाउने अधिकार पाएका हुन् । निर्माता अधिकारी पनि ‘छ माया छपक्कै २’का निर्देशक दीपेन्द्र लामासँग मिलेर अर्को चलचित्रको तयारीमा लागिसकेका छन् । Kathmandu. A dispute has erupted between producer Rohit Adhikari and lead actor Deepak Raj Giri after the film 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2', which was released in the last Dashain festival, flopped at the box office. Giri has objected to Adhikari's statement given to the Nepal Press. The film's sole producer, Adhikari, had told Nepal Press that he had lost Rs 1.5 crore while investing Rs 34 million in 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2'. He has also expressed dissatisfaction with Giri on various issues. He had made allegations that Giri had tampered with the script arbitrarily, that he was not even allowed to watch the film before it passed the censors, that he had sold the overseas rights arbitrarily, and that the film had included advertisements for two big companies without his knowledge. Actor Giri, however, has termed it as unnecessary media hype. He alleges that the official was the first to violate the agreement. Giri told Nepal Press, "I don't want to do media manipulation. Whatever is said, everything is said on paper. If there is dissatisfaction, we will go to the legal process, there is no point in doing media manipulation." Giri alleges that the production officer violated clause 12 of the agreement between the two parties. Clause 12 of the agreement, subtitled 'Confidentiality', states, 'Neither party shall disclose to any third party any financial, commercial, technical or creative information related to this agreement without mutual written consent.' Giri said that if there is any more media speculation, his team is discussing preparations to take legal action against the defamation case. He said that he will not comment further as everything has been said in point 12 of the agreement and other documents. A legal professional near Giri says that the official may be charged with defamation and a banking offense, including check bounce. The lawyer said, "We have two of his checks with us. It seems that not only defamation, but other cases may also be attracted." The lawyer said that Giri does not have to pay the remaining money for overseas rights. He said that Giri should only pay the official if the money came from abroad and was kept with him. "After the film flopped, overseas distributors refused to take it. How will the money come after the film is discontinued?" the lawyer said, "If he had brought the money and kept it with him, he would have had to pay!" 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2' has so far collected only around 3.5 crores. From this collection, the producer Adhikari is expected to earn around 1.5 crores. Adhikari said that around 6.5 lakhs have been earned from overseas. Giri has got the digital rights of the film as per the previous agreement. Giri had said that he would take all the responsibility alone after the film failed. He has already announced 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 3'. Since Deepak Raj owns the copyright of the film, he has also got the right to make the sequel. The production officer has also started preparing for another film in collaboration with 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2' director Dipendra Lama.

चलचित्रको डिजिटल राइटस् पूर्वसहमतिअनुसार गिरीले पाएका छन् । चलचित्र असफल भएपछि सबै जिम्मेवारी आफूले एक्लै लिने गिरीले बताएका थिए । उनले ‘छ माया छपक्कै ३’ को घोषणा गरिसकेका छन् । चलचित्रको कपिराइट दीपकराजसँग भएकाले सिक्वेल पनि उनले नै बनाउने अधिकार पाएका हुन् । निर्माता अधिकारी पनि ‘छ माया छपक्कै २’का निर्देशक दीपेन्द्र लामासँग मिलेर अर्को चलचित्रको तयारीमा लागिसकेका छन् ।

Kathmandu. A dispute has erupted between producer Rohit Adhikari and lead actor Deepak Raj Giri after the film 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2', which was released in the last Dashain festival, flopped at the box office. Giri has objected to Adhikari's statement given to the Nepal Press. The film's sole producer, Adhikari, had told Nepal Press that he had lost Rs 1.5 crore while investing Rs 34 million in 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2'. He has also expressed dissatisfaction with Giri on various issues. He had made allegations that Giri had tampered with the script arbitrarily, that he was not even allowed to watch the film before it passed the censors, that he had sold the overseas rights arbitrarily, and that the film had included advertisements for two big companies without his knowledge. Actor Giri, however, has termed it as unnecessary media hype. He alleges that the official was the first to violate the agreement. Giri told Nepal Press, "I don't want to do media manipulation. Whatever is said, everything is said on paper. If there is dissatisfaction, we will go to the legal process, there is no point in doing media manipulation." Giri alleges that the production officer violated clause 12 of the agreement between the two parties. Clause 12 of the agreement, subtitled 'Confidentiality', states, 'Neither party shall disclose to any third party any financial, commercial, technical or creative information related to this agreement without mutual written consent.' Giri said that if there is any more media speculation, his team is discussing preparations to take legal action against the defamation case. He said that he will not comment further as everything has been said in point 12 of the agreement and other documents. A legal professional near Giri says that the official may be charged with defamation and a banking offense, including check bounce. The lawyer said, "We have two of his checks with us. It seems that not only defamation, but other cases may also be attracted." The lawyer said that Giri does not have to pay the remaining money for overseas rights. He said that Giri should only pay the official if the money came from abroad and was kept with him. "After the film flopped, overseas distributors refused to take it. How will the money come after the film is discontinued?" the lawyer said, "If he had brought the money and kept it with him, he would have had to pay!" 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2' has so far collected only around 3.5 crores. From this collection, the producer Adhikari is expected to earn around 1.5 crores. Adhikari said that around 6.5 lakhs have been earned from overseas. Giri has got the digital rights of the film as per the previous agreement. Giri had said that he would take all the responsibility alone after the film failed. He has already announced 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 3'. Since Deepak Raj owns the copyright of the film, he has also got the right to make the sequel. The production officer has also started preparing for another film in collaboration with 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2' director Dipendra Lama.
